brief:
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu told American citizens that Iranian access to nuclear weapons poses a greater danger than rising fuel costs, Middle East Eye reported. He claimed gas prices would decline once Tehran's "regime disappears," framing the Iranian nuclear question as a priority concern for US voters.

The statement appears aimed at reshaping American political discourse around energy costs, redirecting focus toward Middle Eastern security threats ahead of regional developments.
dek: Netanyahu tells Americans: Iran's access to nuclear arms worse than rising gas prices Israeli prime minister Benjamin Netanyahu warned US citizens of Iranian access to nuclear weapons, claiming that gas prices will decrease once Tehran's "regime disappears".
title: Netanyahu warns Americans Iran's nuclear threat outweighs gas prices
